evidence.claim: The policy has sections on information collected and how, how it is used, retention, disclosures, third-party tracking and online advertising, and user controls.

Robinhood says it and third-party partners may use cookies, pixels and device identifiers, including third-party advertising and analytics services, to collect information about your use of its Services.
Robinhood says it may develop or use AI functionality, including machine learning, to improve its products and services and protect accounts from fraud.
Robinhood advises reviewing mobile device settings for features to opt out of or into information collection for behavioral advertising.
Robinhood says that if you delete your Social profile it deletes your Social data under applicable law and its retention policies.
Robinhood says data collected to opt in to text messaging will not be sold or shared with third parties for their marketing or promotional purposes; no broader sale statement was established.
